LCARS Design System

An LCARS-inspired design system: tokens, component specs and reference implementations. This page is generated from tokens/. Terminal first; CSS and SVG later.

TNG2375Anatomy

Pill anatomy

Start cap
Half-circle, radius 0.5h, block color.
Label block
Block color, label in label-ink, uppercase, 0.5h padding after the label.
Value
On the page background, value color, 0.5h gap each side.
End cap
Half-circle, radius 0.5h, block color, standing alone.

Here the caps are CSS border radii. Terminals draw them with the Nerd Font half-circle glyphs U+E0B6 and U+E0B4; see impl/shell/README.md.

States

LITvalue OFFvalue BLINKvalue

Blink alternates lit and the dimmed hue (×0.4, snapped to the 0x33 grid) every 1s. With reduced motion it holds lit and marks the end cap with a dashed outline.

TNG palette

The Next Generation era (default). Named colors from trekcolors lcars_colors(), series 2357 and 2369: https://leonawicz.github.io/trekcolors/reference/lcars_colors.html. Every color but eggplant (#664466) sits on the 0x33 grid.

Roles

  • label-ink black #000000
  • emphasis-ink pale-canary #ffff99
  • unlit unlit #333333
  • value golden-tanoi #ffcc66
  • muted blue-bell #9999cc
  • alert chestnut-rose #cc6666
  • warning atomic-tangerine #ff9900
  • ok anakiwa #99ccff
  • accent atomic-tangerine #ff9900
  • accent-2 lilac #cc99cc
  • accent-3 melrose #9999ff
  • accent-4 anakiwa #99ccff
  • accent-5 hopbush #cc6699
  • added tanoi #ffcc99
  • removed chestnut-rose #cc6666

Examples

A system readout:

CTX42% 5H8% 7D91% ↻Tue DISK▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░ 120G free MODELOpus BRmain DIFFclean

A navigation row with an alert indicator:

PATH~/code/lcars BRfeature PR#12 APPR DIFF+12 -3 ERR1

2375 palette

The 2375 series from trekcolors lcars_2375(), named by stardate year as trekcolors names it: https://leonawicz.github.io/trekcolors/reference/lcars_colors.html (data: https://github.com/leonawicz/trekcolors/blob/master/data-raw/data.R). Its colors sit off the 0x33 grid; dimmed colors still snap to it.

Roles

  • label-ink black #000000
  • emphasis-ink sandy-brown #ee9955
  • unlit unlit #333333
  • value sandy-brown #ee9955
